abilityRules.confirmed: Only A03C has a source description with an explicit effect: landing damage 300 to enemy ground units, a stun duration field, and an Infernal duration field. Its target coordinates, cooldown, actual field values, parent-death behavior, and web-scaled value remain unresolved.

abilityRules.unknown: ACct, A024, A023, A02W, A03B, A03H, A01G, A03F, A02R, and A02Q must not receive inferred effects from their owner unit or name similarity.
abilityRules.webGate: All boss special abilities are disabled for easy through impossible and may be enabled only when the selected difficulty has bossSpecialAbilitiesEnabled=true (currently Unlimited). This preserves the current product flag; difficulty selection and balance tuning are outside this task.
abilityRules.targeting: No ability implementation may assume unit, building, chicken, hero, ground, or air targeting; that is unresolved per ability. A03C's source text restricts landing damage to enemy ground units.
abilityRules.timing: No ability implementation may invent a period, range, cooldown, duration, stack rule, or web damage value from an ability name. SP-10-06 supplies the shared clock after a per-ability policy or source fact exists.
